Web Design + SEO

Web design and SEO, built together.

Nifty Websites builds your website and its search visibility at the same time, not as an afterthought. Every site we make includes SEO optimised content, schema markup, technical setup, and Google Search Console and Analytics. That is an SEO build worth about $2,000, included at no extra cost, so your site launches ready to be found.

What the free $2,000 SEO build covers.

Other agencies charge thousands for search visibility, or leave you to work it out. We write and build it into every website, so you launch ready to rank.

SEO optimised content, written for you

Keyword researched page copy that reads well and is built to rank, written as part of the build.

Schema markup on every page

Structured data so Google and AI search engines can understand and quote your business.

Technical SEO done right

Speed, mobile, indexing and a clean site structure set up correctly from launch, not patched later.

Search Console and Analytics setup

Tracking configured so you can see the enquiries your website brings in from day one.

Why together

A website and its SEO are one job, not two.

SEO cannot be bolted on later

When search is added after the design is finished, the structure, headings and content usually have to be reworked. Building both together means the site is right the first time.

Design and search are the same decisions

How a page is laid out, what it says first, and how it is structured all affect both conversion and ranking. We make those decisions once, together.

You launch ranking, not waiting

Because the SEO work is part of the build, your site goes live already optimised, instead of waiting on a separate phase two invoice.

How it works

From research to real enquiries.

Research and keywords

We research what your customers actually search for, and map the site around those intents before any design starts.

Design around intent

Every page is designed to answer a real search need and guide the visitor toward an enquiry.

Build with SEO baked in

We develop the site with the content, schema, technical setup and speed work included as part of the build.

Launch with tracking

We go live, connect Search Console and Analytics, and hand you a site that is measured in real enquiries.

What you get

Everything a search ready website needs, in one build.

Typical turnaround is two to four weeks depending on the size of the site. Final inclusions and pricing are confirmed in your free quote.

  • Up to date, keyword researched page contentWritten for search and for your customers.
  • Schema markup across the siteApplied to the pages where it is relevant and accurate.
  • Technical SEO configurationSpeed, mobile, indexing and clean architecture.
  • Search Console and AnalyticsSet up and verified so tracking works from launch.
  • Mobile first, fast loading buildBecause site speed and mobile affect both ranking and conversion.
  • One point of contactFrom first brief through to launch, with clear timelines.

Common questions

Web design and SEO, answered.

What is included in web design and SEO?

Web design and SEO from Nifty Websites means your site is built and optimised for search at the same time. Every build includes SEO optimised content, schema markup, technical SEO setup, and Google Search Console and Analytics, an SEO build worth about $2,000, at no extra cost.

How much does a website with SEO cost?

Websites start from $499 for a starter site and $999 for a professional business site, and the SEO build is included on every plan rather than charged separately. Final pricing depends on the number of pages and features, and is confirmed in a free quote.

Is the $2,000 SEO build really free?

Yes. The SEO content, schema, technical setup and analytics configuration are part of the standard build at no extra cost. The figure of about $2,000 reflects what this work commonly costs when bought separately.

Do I need SEO if I already have a website?

If your current site was not built with search in mind, a redesign that includes SEO usually gives you a stronger result than adding SEO on top of an older structure. We can review your existing site and advise honestly on a free quote.

Will this get my site to page one of Google?

We build every site to the standard that ranks, with clean structure, useful content and correct technical setup, but no agency can guarantee a specific position on Google. What we can promise is a site that is built to be found and measured on real enquiries.
